interface.longDescription: Explore Creditism, AYU and Common Planet through Sage. The plugin preserves its frozen educational instructions and eight public reference documents. A read-only MCP service searches those documents and retrieves exact, bounded source passages with provenance. ChatGPT composes responses in the visitor’s own account; the service does not generate answers, use embeddings, call AI models or require an OpenAI API key. Creditism and AYU designs are explained with their evidence and limits.
defaultPrompt: How does AYU differ from mature Creditism?
What has been demonstrated, and what remains a design?
